verdict.rationale: Blink documents an Appearance settings section for styling the terminal with themes and fonts, and says users can add their own themes and fonts beyond the bundled ones, which covers font and color customization. Cursor appearance is never mentioned, and no evidence explicitly says the settings persist. Missing for 10: cursor appearance customization, explicit documentation of settings persistence, independent or hands-on corroboration of theme/font customization.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can customize the font, colors, and cursor appearance of my terminal and persist the settings

citations.quote: Appearance: Style your terminal with themes and fonts.
You can rock your terminal and roll your own themes and fonts beyond our included ones.
